aism_behavior: class-driven (no AISM counterpart -- AISM's argument.py has no signature vocabulary, no convention profile, and no regime reasoning of any kind).
notes: The fail-closed rule of memo section 6 (review LB6): a malformed or unparseable signature is an ERROR, NEVER 'no signature'. Here one trailing comma inside `pre` makes the block unparseable JSON. If the parser degraded that to 'absent', the shard would silently skip the entailment check entirely -- and under `signatures: required` it would be reported under a DIFFERENT name (`signature-missing`), sending the author to look for a block that is right there. The gate reports the malformation and does NOT also report it missing: one fault, one finding.
